assumptions.transmon_regime: E_J/E_C ≫ 1 (typically 30–100): charge dispersion exponentially suppressed, weak anharmonicity.
assumptions.dispersive_regime: |g/Δ| ≪ 1 and photon number well below n_crit = Δ²/4g².
assumptions.rwa: Rotating-wave approximation: counter-rotating terms dropped (drive/coupling ≪ transition frequency).
assumptions.two_level: Only the two lowest levels of each element are kept.
assumptions.three_level: Transmon truncated to |0⟩,|1⟩,|2⟩; higher levels neglected.
assumptions.markov: Bath correlation time much shorter than system time scales (Born–Markov, secular approximation).
assumptions.independent_errors: Gate errors on different gates and qubits are statistically independent.
assumptions.average_gate_fidelities: Each gate error is the average (Clifford-twirled) error rate from randomized benchmarking.
assumptions.no_crosstalk: Classical drive crosstalk and ZZ during idles neglected unless listed in the calibration.
assumptions.calibration_static: Calibration values are constant over the run (no drift).
assumptions.queue_time_excluded: Wall time excludes any scheduler or queue wait on a shared machine.
assumptions.reset_policy_active: Qubits are reset by measurement plus conditional X (active reset).
assumptions.reset_policy_passive: Qubits relax for 5·T1 between shots (passive reset).
assumptions.lumped_thermal: Each stage is one isothermal node with a single heat capacity.
assumptions.steady_state: Time derivatives set to zero: loads balance cooling power.
assumptions.grey_body: Radiative exchange between concentric shields with effective emissivity ε_eff = ε/(2−ε).
assumptions.cable_loss_cold_end: Distributed coax loss is lumped at the cold end of each segment.
assumptions.phase_preserving_amp: Amplifier is phase-preserving: at least half a photon of added noise (Caves bound).
assumptions.matched_filter: Readout integration weights equal the difference of the mean |0⟩/|1⟩ trajectories.
assumptions.gaussian_iq: IQ clouds are Gaussian with equal covariance for the two states.
assumptions.lamb_dicke: η²(2n̄+1) ≪ 1: laser–ion coupling expanded to first order in the motion.
assumptions.single_mode_ms: Mølmer–Sørensen gate drives one motional mode; spectator modes neglected.
assumptions.code_capacity: Errors only on data qubits between perfect syndrome measurements.
assumptions.circuit_level_noise: Every gate, idle, reset and measurement carries depolarizing/flip noise with probability p.
assumptions.little_endian: Qubit q[0] is the least significant bit of the basis-state index.
assumptions.pure_state: The state is pure; for mixed states use the density-operator form.
assumptions.clifford_twirl: The error channel is twirled to a depolarizing channel by random Cliffords.
assumptions.ideal_pulse_shape: Sample-rate quantization and mixer imperfections neglected.
